verdict.rationale: Zero's README claims a Unified Inbox that connects multiple email providers such as Gmail and Outlook. However, only Gmail integration has documented setup (Google OAuth), and the founder describes it as working on top of Gmail, so multi-provider support beyond Gmail is unproven rather than concretely contradicted. Missing for 10: documented Microsoft 365/Outlook connection setup, any IMAP support, evidence of multiple simultaneous accounts in one view, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
